footnotes.text: 3. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students. Although students may take up to 43 hours to meet all Carolina Core requirements, students in the Early Childhood Education program must complete two Carolina Core approved “overlay-eligible” courses in order to graduate on time and avoid summer courses or taking more than five courses in some semesters.

footnotes.text: 4. One Life Science and one Physical/Earth Science are required (at least one must be four credit hours with a lab).
